csv_project_name: Design for On-Call Bridge Repair Rehab & Preservation
csv_scope_of_work: The SOUTH CAROLINA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION (SCDOT) requests a letter of interest and a proposal containing qualifications from all interested consulting firms experienced in providing Bridge Repair, Rehabilitation and Preservation Design Services necessary for the development and delivery of bridge projects statewide in South Carolina. Requested services include but are not limited to: project management, surveys, environmental services, traffic engineering, roadway design, structural/bridge design and analysis, hydrology and hydraulic design, subsurface investigation and geotechnical design, utility coordination, railroad coordination, subsurface utilities engineering, right of way support services, construction support services, lead based paint and asbestos assessment, construction cost estimating and scheduling, value engineering, non-motorized transportation design, QA/QC review, grant application assistance, and other related duties as deemed necessary. SCDOT may utilize the selected consulting firms to assist in delivering projects during any phase of project development ranging from project initiation to construction completion. The project team should be capable of providing all services outlined above for all bridges in SCDOT s inventory including complex and movable structures.
